_method: Expected payable amount per case, computed BY HAND (calculator arithmetic) from the case's expenses and the supplied policy's literal sub-limits: room 1% of SI (flat, not per day), doctor/surgeon fees 25%, medicines/diagnostics/other 40%, ambulance min(1% of SI, INR 1,000), domiciliary aggregate 20% of SI; pre/post-hospitalisation payable in full when inside the 30/60-day windows. NOT_ADMISSIBLE cases pay 0. NEEDS_REVIEW cases have no gold payable (null) because no safe amount can be stated. The 'room cap is flat, not per day' reading is an interpretation of the policy text (see README known limitations).

PUB-001.derivation: 5,000 room (1% of 500,000) + 30,000 doctor + 90,000 meds + 5,000 pre + 7,000 post + 1,000 ambulance cap

CUST-005.derivation: inside 30-day initial waiting period (no accident carve-out in supplied text)
